test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

To give up a throne voluntarily
solution:
The correct answer is "Abdicate"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• ** Abdicate** is a verb form that signifies stepping down from one's position and power.
 
• To give up a throne voluntarily can also be said as the king/higher authority giving up his/her power and position. 
 
• Some other synonyms of abdicate are forgone, relinquish, renounce, and step down.
 
 
• Example: The coordinator abdicate yesterday.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ Other words that don't suit this sentence because they have different meanings such as

 
• Vacate means to leave or empty.

 
 
• Example: The owner said to pay the rent or vacate the room.
 
 
 
• Allocate means to assign for a specific purpose 
 
 
• Example: The seat has been allocated for Pwd students.
 
 
 
• Eradicate means to destroy something
 
 
• Example: Shilla eradicated the files.
